module_summary: NAPOT address decoder wrapper: renames base/mask rule fields into range-rule format and delegates matching to a cc_addr_decode_dync instance in NAPOT mode.

anchors.name: addr_i
anchors.why: Address to decode, passed to child decoder.

anchors.name: addr_map_i
anchors.why: Rule table of idx/base/mask entries defining the address map.

anchors.name: range_addr_map
anchors.why: Rules remapped to idx/start/end fields for child decoder.

anchors.name: idx_o
anchors.why: Decoded rule index output from child decoder.

anchors.name: dec_valid_o
anchors.why: Indicates a rule matched the address.

anchors.name: dec_error_o
anchors.why: Indicates no rule matched the address.

anchors.name: en_default_idx_i
anchors.why: Enables default index when no rule matches.

anchors.name: default_idx_i
anchors.why: Default index used on no match when enabled.

groups.name: Rule remap
groups.description: Renames base/mask rule fields to start/end for child.

groups.name: NAPOT decoder
groups.description: cc_addr_decode_dync instance matching address to rule index.
